map.💡 基准寿命(60℃)×2^((60-T)/10)×污染系数×油量系数；每升高1: Tip: base life (60 °C) times 2^((60 minus T)/10) times contamination factor times oil-volume factor; every 10 °C rise halves oil life

map.📚 深度解析：润滑油更换周期（Arrhenius 温度法则）: In-depth: Lubricating Oil Change Interval (Arrhenius temperature law)
map.换油计划：按油箱容量、温度与日运行时间估算换油周期: Change-plan: estimate the change interval from tank capacity, temperature and daily run time
map.油品比选：对比矿物油/半合成油/全合成油的周期差异: Oil comparison: compare mineral / semi-synthetic / full-synthetic interval differences
map.工况改善：量化控温、加大油箱对周期的延长效果: Condition improvement: quantify the extension from temperature control and larger tank
map.算法：温度系数 = 2^((60−工作温度)/10)（Arrhenius Q10: Algorithm: temperature factor = 2^((60 minus operating temperature)/10) (Arrhenius Q10 = 2, baseline 60 °C); oil-volume factor = 1 + 0.2 times log2(max(tank capacity / 20, 0.5)) (baseline 20 L, lower bound 0.5); change interval = oil base life times temperature factor times contamination level times oil-volume factor (h), then convert to days, months and years by daily run hours. Oil base life: mineral 6000 h, semi-synthetic 10000 h, full-synthetic 15000 h; contamination: clean 1.0, general 0.7, harsh/dusty 0.5.
map.例：油箱 50L、75℃、日运行 8h、半合成油、一般环境 → 温度系数 0.3: Example: tank 50 L, 75 °C, 8 h/day, semi-synthetic, general environment gives temperature factor 0.3536, oil-volume factor 1.2644, change interval 3129 h about 391 days about 13.04 months, hint as mid-high temperature, suggest semi-synthetic or full-synthetic oil, long change interval, note periodic sampling. Switch to full-synthetic and drop temperature to 60 °C, clean environment, 20 L tank, 24 h/day gives temperature factor 1, oil-volume factor 1, interval 15000 h about 625 days about 20.83 months. If mineral oil at 95 °C, harsh environment gives temperature factor only 0.0884, interval 335 h, hint as high-temperature duty, strongly suggest full-synthetic oil, frequent changes, suggest improving duty or enlarging tank.
map.为什么油箱越大周期越长？: Why does a larger tank give a longer interval?
map.油量越大，单位油量承受的热负荷与污染稀释程度越低，油质劣化更慢。工具以 20L: More oil means lower heat load per unit oil and more dilution of contaminants, so the oil degrades more slowly. The tool uses 20 L as baseline on a log scale; raising tank from 20 L to 50 L gives oil-volume factor about 1.26, to 100 L about 1.46.
map.温度系数 2^((60−T)/10) 怎么用？: How to use the temperature factor 2^((60 minus T)/10)?
map.表示以 60℃ 为基准，温度每升高 10℃ 寿命减半、每降低 10℃ 寿命翻倍。: It means baseline 60 °C, every 10 °C rise halves life, every 10 °C drop doubles it. At 75 °C the factor is about 0.354 (life drops to 35 percent), at 95 °C only about 0.088, so temperature control is the most effective way to extend the change interval.
